en: Young one, you've finally arrived. The forest to the east has been restless lately, can you investigate?
zh_CN: 年轻人，你终于来了。村子东边的森林里最近不太平，你能去调查一下吗？

en: I've already investigated, it was no big deal.
zh_CN: 我早就调查过了，没什么大不了的。

en: Excellent! Here are some rations for the road. Be careful.
zh_CN: 太好了！这是我给你的一些干粮，路上小心。

en: Alright, go and prepare then. The safety of our village rests on you.
zh_CN: 好吧，那你先去准备一下吧，村子的安危就靠你了。

en: Oh? I couldn't tell you were so skilled at such a young age! This is your [shake]reward[/shake].
zh_CN: 哦？看不出来你年纪轻轻，身手却如此了得！这是给你的[shake]奖励[/shake]。
